_comment: One entry per Behatsdaa wallet/giftcard, keyed by wallet id (the number at the end of its saved filename). 'file' must match a JSON file in this same data/ folder — a saved copy of https://back.behatsdaa.org.il/api/cards/GetWalletChain?walletId=<id>. Fill in name / discount_percent / max_deposit_per_month for each entry below, then run: python -m deals scrape --source behatsdaa. Entries missing discount_percent (or with active:false) are skipped with a warning, not an error. Keys starting with '_' (like this one) are comments and are ignored by the loader.

3336.name: ארנק בתשלום עם כרטיס פייטר 15% הנחה
